help:
A GitHub MCP server that handles various tools and resources.

Usage:
  github-mcp-server [command]

Available Commands:
  completion    Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  generate-docs Generate documentation for tools and toolsets
  help          Help about any command
  http          Start HTTP server
  list-scopes   List OAuth scope policies for enabled tools
  stdio         Start stdio server

Flags:
      --content-window-size int          Specify the content window size (default 5000)
      --enable-command-logging           When enabled, the server will log all command requests and responses to the log file
      --exclude-tools strings            Comma-separated list of tool names to disable regardless of other settings
      --export-translations              Save translations to a JSON file
      --features strings                 Comma-separated list of feature flags to enable
      --gh-host string                   Specify the GitHub hostname (for GitHub Enterprise etc.)
  -h, --help                             help for github-mcp-server
      --insiders                         Enable insiders features
      --lockdown-mode                    Enable lockdown mode
      --log-file string                  Path to log file
      --read-only                        Restrict the server to read-only operations
      --repo-access-cache-ttl duration   Override the repo access cache TTL (e.g. 1m, 0s to disable) (default 5m0s)
      --tools strings                    Comma-separated list of specific tools to enable
      --toolsets strings                 Comma-separated list of tool groups to enable (no spaces).
                                         Available: actions, code_quality, code_security, copilot, copilot_issue_intents,
                                         	     dependabot, discussions, gists, git, governance, issues, labels,
                                         	     notifications, orgs, projects, pull_requests, repos, secret_protection,
                                         	     security_advisories, stargazers, users
                                         Special toolset keywords:
                                           - all: Enables all available toolsets
                                           - default: Enables the default toolset configuration of:
                                         	     context, copilot, issues, pull_requests, repos, users
                                         Examples:
                                           - --toolsets=actions,gists,notifications
                                           - Default + additional: --toolsets=default,actions,gists
                                           - All tools: --toolsets=all
  -v, --version                          version for github-mcp-server

Use "github-mcp-server [command] --help" for more information about a command.
stdio_help:
Start a server that communicates via standard input/output streams using JSON-RPC messages.

Usage:
  github-mcp-server stdio [flags]

Flags:
      --app-id string                 GitHub App ID or client ID, enabling non-interactive server-to-server authentication
      --app-installation-id string    GitHub App installation ID to mint installation access tokens for
      --app-private-key-path string   Path to the GitHub App private key (PEM). Preferred over GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY: keeps the key off the command line and out of the environment
  -h, --help                          help for stdio
      --oauth-callback-port int       Fixed local port for the OAuth callback server. Defaults to a random port; set a fixed port when mapping it through Docker
      --oauth-client-id string        OAuth App or GitHub App client ID, enabling interactive OAuth login when no token is set
      --oauth-client-secret string    OAuth client secret, if the app requires one (it is a public, non-confidential credential for distributed clients)
      --oauth-scopes strings          Comma-separated OAuth scopes to request; also filters tools to those scopes. Defaults to the full supported set

Global Flags:
      --content-window-size int          Specify the content window size (default 5000)
      --enable-command-logging           When enabled, the server will log all command requests and responses to the log file
      --exclude-tools strings            Comma-separated list of tool names to disable regardless of other settings
      --export-translations              Save translations to a JSON file
      --features strings                 Comma-separated list of feature flags to enable
      --gh-host string                   Specify the GitHub hostname (for GitHub Enterprise etc.)
      --insiders                         Enable insiders features
      --lockdown-mode                    Enable lockdown mode
      --log-file string                  Path to log file
      --read-only                        Restrict the server to read-only operations
      --repo-access-cache-ttl duration   Override the repo access cache TTL (e.g. 1m, 0s to disable) (default 5m0s)
      --tools strings                    Comma-separated list of specific tools to enable
      --toolsets strings                 Comma-separated list of tool groups to enable (no spaces).
                                         Available: actions, code_quality, code_security, copilot, copilot_issue_intents,
                                         	     dependabot, discussions, gists, git, governance, issues, labels,
                                         	     notifications, orgs, projects, pull_requests, repos, secret_protection,
                                         	     security_advisories, stargazers, users
                                         Special toolset keywords:
                                           - all: Enables all available toolsets
                                           - default: Enables the default toolset configuration of:
                                         	     context, copilot, issues, pull_requests, repos, users
                                         Examples:
                                           - --toolsets=actions,gists,notifications
                                           - Default + additional: --toolsets=default,actions,gists
                                           - All tools: --toolsets=all

info.instructions:
The GitHub MCP Server provides tools to interact with GitHub platform.

Tool selection guidance:
	1. Use 'list_*' tools for broad, simple retrieval and pagination of all items of a type (e.g., all issues, all PRs, all branches) with basic filtering.
	2. Use 'search_*' tools for targeted queries with specific criteria, keywords, or complex filters (e.g., issues with certain text, PRs by author, code containing functions).

Context management:
	1. Use pagination whenever possible with batches of 5-10 items.
	2. Use minimal_output parameter set to true if the full information is not needed to accomplish a task.

Tool usage guidance:
	1. For 'search_*' tools: Use separate 'sort' and 'order' parameters if available for sorting results - do not include 'sort:' syntax in query strings. Query strings should contain only search criteria (e.g., 'org:google language:python'), not sorting instructions. Always call 'get_me' first to understand current user permissions and context. ## Issues

Check 'list_issue_types' first for organizations to use proper issue types. Use 'search_issues' before creating new issues to avoid duplicates. Always set 'state_reason' when closing issues. ## Pull Requests

PR review workflow: Always use 'pull_request_review_write' with method 'create' to create a pending review, then 'add_comment_to_pending_review' to add comments, and finally 'pull_request_review_write' with method 'submit_pending' to submit the review for complex reviews with line-specific commen

tools_call: not run in our build: every GitHub tool calls the GitHub API and needs a real token
notes: Default toolsets per `stdio --help` in v2.0.3: context, copilot, issues, pull_requests, repos, users (4+2+10+10+19+1 = 46 tools, matches the measured default). The README's 'default' list omits copilot.
Per-toolset counts sum to 92 while --toolsets=all gives 91; not investigated further.
v2.0.3 has no dynamic-toolsets flag in --help; it has --tools, --exclude-tools, --read-only, --lockdown-mode, --oauth-scopes (also filters tools to those scopes).
Lockdown mode (README): a best-effort filter of public-repo content whose author lacks push access, meant to reduce prompt injection; the README says it is not an authorization boundary.
With the dummy token the server logs 'failed to fetch token scopes, continuing without scope filtering' and still lists tools; no GitHub data was read.

Token cost: one gemini-3.5-flash-lite request per configuration, tool_tokens = tokens_in minus the same request with no tools (8 tokens). Rasoi's 15 tools cost 1,912 tokens, the same figure L4 measured on gemini-3.8-flash.
